item.title: 'Do not eat' warning issued over soup sold at three supermarkets
item.body: The Food Standards Agency has issued a 'do not eat' warning for soup sold at Tesco, Sainsbury's and Waitrose. It says the cans may 'swell and potentially rupture' because of a manufacturing fault.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚨 'Do not eat' warning issued over soup sold at three supermarkets

The Food Standards Agency has issued a 'do not eat' warning for soup sold at Tesco, Sainsbury's and Waitrose. It says the cans may 'swell and potentially rupture' because of a manufacturing fault.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 9 November, 12:50

#BreakingNews #FoodSafety #Recall
